menu.title: Dinner menu roulette
menu.subtitle: Spin your lunch or dinner choices. Temporarily exclude a picked menu for this round and restore the original choices.

faq.a: Yes. Use it in a browser without an account or app installation.

faq.q: How many menu entries can I add?
faq.a: Use 2 to 12 entries. Newly typed names can contain up to 20 characters. Edit the original list before spinning; temporary skips are a separate action.
Start with dinner or choose lunch, Korean, Chinese, Japanese, Western, street food, late-night delivery, cafe or penalty presets. You can edit the original candidates.

faq.q: Can I share the roulette with a friend?
faq.a: The URL contains the original candidate list. It does not include the picked result or temporary skips. Copy the result text or save its image separately.

faq.q: How is this different from the other menu picker?
faq.a: Menu roulette draws from the candidates you enter. The separate menu picker suggests choices by category and situation.

faq.q: Can I use it for more than lunch?
faq.a: You can use your own candidate list for dinner, desserts, cafes or another choice.

faq.q: How can I skip a menu only for this draw?
faq.a: Choose Skip for this draw on the result to skip every entry with the same name. Original rows and their order stay intact and return when restored. At least 2 entries must remain available.

faq.q: Do temporary skips change meal history or the weekly plan?
faq.a: No. Skipping does not mark a menu as eaten or change weekly-plan candidates. Existing meal-history exclusions remain separate; restoring a temporary skip does not override them.

faq.q: Can I save temporary skips or send them in a link?
faq.a: They stay only in page memory and clear when the original candidates or effective meal exclusions change, or when you reload. Links share only the original list. Restoring does not automatically spin again.

mealPlan.title: 7-day meal plan
mealPlan.description: Choose one meal for each date. Fill empty days from the current wheel candidates or enter menus yourself. Planning does not change the wheel result or meals already eaten.
mealPlan.dateHint: Choose a start date from 2000-01-01 to 2200-12-25. Seven days from that date are shown.
mealPlan.fillHint: Uses the {count} current wheel candidates, excluding duplicates and menus already used in these seven days. Days remain empty if there are not enough candidates.
mealPlan.filled: Filled {filled} days. {remaining} days remain empty; {skipped} invalid candidates were excluded. Save to confirm these changes.
mealPlan.saveHint: Changing the start date keeps your pending edits. Saving updates only changed dates and preserves the rest. Clear a day and save to delete its stored plan.
mealPlan.historyAdded: Added ‘{menu}’ on {date} to eaten meals. The plan was kept.
mealPlan.historyDuplicate: This menu is already recorded as eaten on that date.
mealPlan.historyFailed: Could not add the eaten meal. Check the message in the eaten-meals panel above and try again. Your plan is unchanged.
mealPlan.historyConflict: Another tab changed the eaten-meals history, so this change was stopped. The latest history is now shown; review it before trying again.
mealPlan.copied: Copied the dates and menus for the current seven days.
mealPlan.copyFailed: Could not copy. Check clipboard permission or download the TXT file.
mealPlan.downloadFailed: Could not prepare the file. Try again or copy the current seven days.
mealPlan.refreshPrompt: Refreshing discards unsaved changes for {count} dates and restores the saved plan.
mealPlan.exportHint: Copy and TXT contain the seven visible dates in chronological order, including pending edits. Empty dates are marked ‘Undecided’. Only today or past dates can be explicitly added to eaten meals.
mealPlan.localOnly: Plans are stored only in this browser, separately from eaten meals. Save up to 90 dates with menus of up to 80 characters. Clearing browser data removes them. They are not included in shared URLs.

errors.invalidData: The saved plan could not be read, so changes are blocked. Existing data is preserved.
errors.unsupportedVersion: This plan uses a different version and cannot be changed here. Existing data is preserved.
errors.unavailable: Browser storage is unavailable, so the plan could not be saved. Check free space or storage settings, then refresh the saved plan.
errors.conflict: Another tab changed the plan. Your pending edits are still here. Refresh the saved plan to review the latest version.
errors.invalidWeek: Enter a valid start date. All seven dates must be within the years 2000–2200.
errors.invalidMenu: Enter a menu of 1–80 characters without line breaks. Saving an empty cell deletes that date's plan.
errors.invalidChanges: Check the changed dates. You can save up to 90 valid, unique dates.
errors.full: You can save up to 90 dates. Clear unused dates and save them with your new plans to free space. Existing plans have not changed.
